implementation_units.goal: Immutable registry for future independently approved and published Terms artifacts.
required_invariants: version and sha256 are immutable after registration
no draft file is auto-promoted into the registry
active customer-facing status requires separate approved publication authority

implementation_units.goal: Append-only acceptance evidence for one authenticated actor and one exact approved Terms version/digest.
required_invariants: actor identity is derived from authenticated server context
client cannot select arbitrary digest authority
version and digest must resolve to one registered approved published Terms artifact
acceptance history cannot be overwritten in place
tenant-scoped reads cannot expose another organization acceptance history

implementation_units.goal: Resolve the one customer-visible approved Terms artifact that the product is allowed to present for acceptance.
required_invariants: resolver never chooses a draft candidate
resolver never trusts a client-provided version
resolver returns exact version, digest, effective date and stable URL
absence of an approved published artifact fails closed instead of fabricating one

implementation_units.goal: Allow future product flow to require acceptance only against exact approved Terms authority.
required_invariants: material Terms change can require new acceptance without rewriting historical evidence
no legal gate closes merely because the technical mechanism exists

verification_plan_for_later_implementati: draft Terms cannot become current Terms regression
historical acceptance remains retrievable after later Terms version exists
